en_meaning: Relating to, similar to, or coming from the stars
vi_meaning: Thuộc về các vì sao, thuộc tinh tú
example_sentence: Ancient navigators across the Polynesian archipelago relied on subtle astral alignments and ocean swells to traverse thousands of miles of open water.

en_meaning: Causing contraction of tissues; sharply critical or harsh in manner
vi_meaning: Làm se da; sắc sảo, gay gắt
example_sentence: The essayist’s astringent critique of contemporary political discourse spared neither party, dissecting their empty rhetoric with surgical precision.

en_meaning: With an attitude or look of suspicion, mistrust, or disapproval
vi_meaning: Nghi ngờ, ngờ vực
example_sentence: Established physicists initially looked askance at the young researcher’s radical hypothesis, doubting that quantum coherence could persist at room temperature.

en_meaning: Not in a straight or level position; crooked or awry
vi_meaning: Nghiêng, xiên xẹo, lệch lạc
example_sentence: After the moderate tremor rattled the gallery, several Renaissance portraits hung noticeably askew against the marble walls.

en_meaning: Harshness of tone, manner, or temper; severity
vi_meaning: Sự gay gắt, sự khắc nghiệt
example_sentence: Startled by the uncharacteristic asperity in the diplomat’s tone, the envoys recognized that formal negotiations had reached an impasse.

en_meaning: A person who has ambitions to achieve something high or noble
vi_meaning: Người có tham vọng, người khao khát vươn tới danh vọng
example_sentence: In Renaissance Florence, every aspirant to the master painters' guild spent grueling years grinding pigments and copying classical sculpture.

en_meaning: Extremely large in size or amount; relating to astronomy
vi_meaning: Vô cùng lớn, khổng lồ; thuộc thiên văn học
example_sentence: Constructing the deep-space particle detector demanded an astronomical outlay of capital that necessitated cost-sharing among a dozen sovereign nations.

en_meaning: Having or showing an ability to accurately assess situations and turn them to one's advantage
vi_meaning: Sắc sảo, tinh khôn, nhạy bén
example_sentence: An astute observer of constitutional jurisprudence, the legal scholar predicted the appellate court’s ruling long before deliberations concluded.

en_meaning: Apart; divided into separate parts or pieces
vi_meaning: Rời ra từng mảnh, tan tác
example_sentence: The sectarian conflict tore the fragile parliamentary coalition asunder, plunging the republic into months of administrative paralysis.

en_meaning: Protection granted by a nation to someone fleeing danger or persecution; a place of refuge
vi_meaning: Nơi tị nạn, sự bảo hộ chính trị
example_sentence: Facing arbitrary detention under the martial decree, the investigative journalist was forced to seek diplomatic asylum within a neutral embassy.

en_meaning: Having parts or aspects that fail to correspond to one another in shape, size, or arrangement; lacking symmetry
vi_meaning: Không đối xứng, bất cân xứng
example_sentence: Strategic analysts observed that the insurgent conflict represented an asymmetric engagement, pitting guerrilla agility against conventional mechanized armor.

en_meaning: The reappearance of a characteristic in an organism after several generations of absence; reversion to an ancestral type
vi_meaning: Sự lại giống, sự xuất hiện lại đặc tính tổ tiên
example_sentence: Paleontologists cited the occasional development of pelvic bones in modern baleen whales as a compelling morphological atavism pointing to terrestrial ancestors.

en_meaning: Disbelieving or lacking belief in the existence of God or gods
vi_meaning: Vô thần, không tin vào thần linh
example_sentence: Radical Enlightenment materialists advanced an atheistic philosophy that rejected divine providence in favor of mechanistic determinism.

en_meaning: A bound collection of maps, charts, or plates illustrating a specific subject
vi_meaning: Tập bản đồ
example_sentence: The navigator consulted a leather-bound seventeenth-century maritime atlas to decipher the antiquated depictions of treacherous Atlantic shoals.

en_meaning: To make amends or reparation for an offense, crime, or error
vi_meaning: Chuộc lỗi, đền bù tội lỗi
example_sentence: In an earnest effort to atone for past environmental destruction, the industrial manufacturer allocated half of its annual profits to wetland reforestation.

en_meaning: An extremely wicked, cruel, or abhorrent act, typically involving physical violence against noncombatants
vi_meaning: Sự tàn bạo, tội ác ghê rợn
example_sentence: International war crimes tribunals meticulously documented every wartime atrocity to ensure that the commanding officers could be prosecuted under global treaties.

en_meaning: To waste away, deteriorate, or decline in effectiveness due to underuse, disease, or neglect
vi_meaning: Hao mòn, teo đi do không sử dụng
example_sentence: Without frequent exposure to challenging analytical tasks, a student's capacity for complex mathematical reasoning can gradually atrophy.

en_meaning: To succeed in achieving or reaching a specified goal, status, or level through sustained effort
vi_meaning: Đạt được, giành được
example_sentence: Only after decades of rigorous experimental trial did the research team attain the stable thermonuclear containment required for clean energy.

en_meaning: Paying close attention to something; watchful, perceptive, or considerately mindful
vi_meaning: Chăm chú, lưu tâm, chu đáo
example_sentence: The master watchmaker remained exquisitely attentive to the minute friction between the interlocking brass escapement gears.

en_meaning: To reduce the force, intensity, effect, or thickness of something; to weaken
vi_meaning: Làm yếu đi, làm giảm bớt cường độ
example_sentence: Coastal wetlands and mangrove fringes serve as crucial buffers that attenuate the kinetic force of incoming tsunami waves.

en_meaning: To provide or serve as clear evidence of; to certify or declare to be true
vi_meaning: Chứng thực, làm chứng cho
example_sentence: The deep wear patterns on the excavated stone grindstones attest to centuries of continuous grain processing by Neolithic villagers.

en_meaning: To regard something as being caused by, belonging to, or originating from a specific person or factor
vi_meaning: Quy cho, gán cho là do
example_sentence: Epidemiologists attribute the precipitous decline in infant mortality during the nineteenth century primarily to municipal sanitation reforms.

en_meaning: The process of gradually reducing the strength, numbers, or effectiveness of something through sustained attack or pressure
vi_meaning: Sự hao mòn dần, sự tiêu hao sinh lực
example_sentence: The protracted trench warfare along the Western Front devolved into an agonizing campaign of attrition that decimated an entire generation.

en_meaning: Not representative of a type, group, or expected pattern; unusual or irregular
vi_meaning: Không điển hình, khác thường
example_sentence: Because the stellar spectra displayed atypical absorption spikes, the astrophysicists suspected that an unseen exoplanet was occluding the star.

en_meaning: Showing a willingness to take surprisingly bold risks; daring or insolently brazen
vi_meaning: Táo bạo, liều lĩnh, quả cảm
example_sentence: Galileo’s audacious defense of heliocentrism openly challenged the prevailing Ptolemaic orthodoxy enforced by the Roman Inquisition.

en_meaning: An official, methodical examination and verification of an organization's financial accounts or operating records
vi_meaning: Sự kiểm toán, cuộc kiểm tra sổ sách kế toán
example_sentence: An independent regulatory audit uncovered pervasive accounting discrepancies that had artificially inflated the bank’s reported quarterly earnings.

en_meaning: Relating to the sense of hearing or the organs of hearing
vi_meaning: Thuộc thính giác
example_sentence: Marine biologists discovered that anthropogenic sonar noise causes acute auditory trauma in deep-diving cetaceans, disrupting their echolocation.

en_meaning: To make something greater in size, value, or strength by adding to it; to supplement
vi_meaning: Gia tăng, tăng cường, bổ sung
example_sentence: To augment their sparse domestic agricultural yields, early industrial city-states established extensive grain import networks across the Mediterranean.

en_meaning: A sign of what will happen in the future; an omen, portent, or practice of divination
vi_meaning: Điềm báo, sự báo trước
example_sentence: In classical antiquity, Roman magistrates rarely undertook major military campaigns without first consulting diviners to interpret augury from animal entrails.

en_meaning: Inspiring reverence, admiration, or solemn respect; majestic, venerable, and imposing
vi_meaning: Uy nghiêm, trang trọng, khả kính
example_sentence: The newly inaugurated chancellor addressed the august assembly of Nobel laureates and university provosts with heartfelt humility.

en_meaning: A circle of luminous light or halo surrounding the head or body of a deity; a radiant corona
vi_meaning: Hào quang, quầng sáng
example_sentence: During total solar eclipses, the lunar disc momentarily obscures the photosphere, unveiling the sun's ghostly aureole shimmering against the darkness.

en_meaning: Relating to or resembling the dawn or the aurora borealis/australis; luminous and iridescent
vi_meaning: Thuộc về cực quang, rực rỡ như rạng đông
example_sentence: Coronal mass ejections from the sun triggered breathtaking auroral displays that bathed the subpolar tundra in ribbons of vibrant luminescence.

en_meaning: Conducive to success; giving or showing favorable signs for the future; propitious
vi_meaning: Thuận lợi, có điềm lành, hứa hẹn may mắn
example_sentence: The ratification of the non-proliferation treaty was universally lauded as an auspicious milestone for postwar multilateral diplomacy.

en_meaning: Severe or strict in manner, attitude, or appearance; plain, unadorned, and without comforts
vi_meaning: Khắc khổ, mộc mạc, nghiêm nghị
example_sentence: The monastic community embraced an austere lifestyle, deliberately eschewing material comforts in favor of silent meditation and labor.

en_meaning: To prove or show that something is true, genuine, or valid
vi_meaning: Xác thực, chứng thực tính chân thật
example_sentence: Through forensic ink dating and provenance analysis, the museum conservator was able to authenticate the unsigned manuscript as an early work by Mary Shelley.

en_meaning: Favoring or enforcing strict obedience to authority, especially that of the government, at the expense of personal freedom
vi_meaning: Độc đoán, chuyên chế
example_sentence: Political theorists caution that when a government systematically curtails judicial independence and suppresses free assembly, it veers dangerously toward authoritarian governance.

en_meaning: Able to be trusted as being accurate or true; reliable, definitive, and showing expert commanding power
vi_meaning: Có thẩm quyền, chuẩn xác, đáng tin cậy
example_sentence: Historians still consider Edward Gibbon’s monumental chronicle to be an authoritative, if stylistically idiosyncratic, treatise on late Roman decline.

en_meaning: Ruling with absolute power and unrestricted authority; tyrannical or dictatorial
vi_meaning: Độc tài, chuyên quyền, toàn quyền
example_sentence: The monarch’s autocratic dissolution of parliament sparked widespread civilian defiance, precipitating a constitutional crisis that reshaped British democracy.

en_meaning: A moving mechanical device made in imitation of a human being; a person who acts in a mechanical, routine manner
vi_meaning: Người máy, cỗ máy tự động, người hành động máy móc
example_sentence: Eighteenth-century inventor Jacques de Vaucanson stunned the European nobility by exhibiting an ornate mechanical automaton capable of playing intricate melodies on a flute.

en_meaning: Acting independently or having the freedom, power, and authority to govern oneself
vi_meaning: Tự trị, độc lập, tự chủ
example_sentence: Deep-sea exploration often requires autonomous underwater submersibles capable of charting uncharted oceanic trenches without real-time human guidance.

en_meaning: A postmortem examination of a body to discover the cause of death or evaluate the nature of disease
vi_meaning: Sự khám nghiệm tử thi
example_sentence: The coroner’s meticulous autopsy confirmed that the deceased diplomat had ingested lethal doses of arsenic several hours before collapsing.

en_meaning: Providing supplementary, additional, or backup help and support
vi_meaning: Phụ trợ, bổ trợ, dự phòng
example_sentence: When severe lightning crippled the regional power grid, the metropolitan hospital immediately transitioned to auxiliary diesel generators to preserve neonatal life-support systems.

en_meaning: A large mass of snow, ice, or rock falling rapidly down a mountainside; an overwhelming accumulation or influx of something
vi_meaning: Tuyết lở, sự dồn dập ồ ạt
example_sentence: The sudden collapse of the major investment bank triggered an avalanche of panic across European credit markets, wiping out billions in equity overnight.

en_meaning: Extreme greed for wealth or material gain; insatiable cupidity
vi_meaning: Lòng tham lam, tính hám của
example_sentence: Gilded Age muckrakers relentlessly castigated the unrestrained avarice of industrial monopolists who hoarded vast fortunes while suppressing workers' wages.

en_meaning: To inflict harm in return for an injury, insult, or wrong done to oneself or someone else
vi_meaning: Báo thù, rửa hận
example_sentence: Consumed by an obsessive drive to avenge his comrades' execution, the revolutionary commander rejected all offers of ceasefire and resumed his guerrilla offensive.

en_meaning: Having a strong dislike of or opposition to something; disinclined
vi_meaning: Không thích, ác cảm, ngần ngại
example_sentence: Risk-averse pension fund trustees favored conservative sovereign bonds over volatile equities, prioritizing capital preservation over speculative yields.

en_meaning: A strong feeling of dislike, opposition, repugnance, or antipathy toward something
vi_meaning: Sự ác cảm, sự ghét bỏ
example_sentence: Behavioral psychologists demonstrate that conditioned gustatory aversion develops rapidly in mammals as an evolutionary defense against ingesting toxic vegetation.

en_meaning: To turn away one's eyes or thoughts; to ward off, prevent, or forestall an undesirable occurrence
vi_meaning: Ngăn chặn, ngoảnh đi, phòng tránh
example_sentence: Swift diplomatic de-escalation by multilateral mediators managed to avert an imminent border clash between the two nuclear-armed states.

en_meaning: A large cage, building, or enclosure for keeping, breeding, and displaying birds
vi_meaning: Chuồng chim lớn, khu nuôi chim
example_sentence: The zoological foundation constructed a climate-controlled aviary spanning five acres to safeguard breeding pairs of critically endangered tropical quetzals.

en_meaning: Having or showing a keen interest in, enthusiasm for, or greed for something
vi_meaning: Khao khát, say mê, tha thiết
example_sentence: An avid bibliophile and classical scholar, Thomas Jefferson amassed thousands of rare volumes that eventually formed the founding collection of the Library of Congress.
